provider_patterns.notes: Updates every few minutes while the stream is live (Cache-Control max-age 300, no Last-Modified). Video IDs change when a resort restarts a stream, so the hourly job should re-read the resort page (or the CamStreamer redirect) for the current ID. When a stream is down the thumbnail shows a promo slate or frozen frame; there is no header to detect that. Hotlinking YouTube thumbnails is a terms question for Chris.
Read the Location header (no body needed) to get the live YouTube ID, then use the YouTube live thumbnail. Stable handle even when the YouTube ID changes.

The oid is in the resort's iframe src/data-src (relay.ozolio.com/pub.api?cmd=embed&oid=...). Returns a current 1920x1080 JPEG with a time stamp burned in; Cache-Control max-age 900; ACAO *. Used by Palisades Tahoe; likely other Alterra/independent resorts.

Known names: Top_Of_Sierra_1, Main_Broadway, Outpost_Arriba, Canyon_Lincoln_Mountain, Eagle_Home. All frozen at 2026-09-17 09:05 UTC; probably restart for winter. Has Last-Modified, so a better winter source than YouTube for Mammoth.

Alias from the resort's player link g1.ipcamlive.com/player/player.php?alias=<alias>. 302-redirects to https://sNN.ipcamlive.com/streams/<streamid>/snapshot.jpg, which has Last-Modified. getcamerastreamstate.php?alias= returns JSON with streamavailable.

frames/last.jpg has a true Last-Modified; manage.hdrelay.com/snapshot always sets Last-Modified to the request time (useless for freshness) and can serve an old frame when the camera is offline. Sites that embed HDRelay.create({id:<playerId>}) or manage.hdrelay.com/webPlayer/iframe/<playerId>: GET https://manage.hdrelay.com/player/<playerId> (public JSON) -> camera.id, plus status.online. bNN.hdrelay.com/camera/<cameraId>/snapshot also works. Freshness warning: for an offline camera even frames/last.jpg can carry a current Last-Modified while serving an old frame (Brian Head stake), so check status.online in the player JSON where a player id is known. Used by Powdr (Snowbird, Copper, Eldora), Mountain Capital Partners (Lee Canyon, Purgatory, Snowbowl...), Diamond Peak, Sugar Bowl, Mt Shasta.

Redirects (302) to the newest file on storageN.roundshot.com, which has Last-Modified. The hash is in https://<client>.roundshot.com/<cam>/settings.json ('hash'); resort pages sometimes embed backend URLs directly (Snowbird). Images are wide panoramas (thumbnail 1340x150, medium ~4000x450, optional is a ~2700x300 cutout). Used by Aspen Snowmass (4 mountains), Snowbird.
webcamId is the 'e' field in window.timelapseview_options[...] next to the widget-v1_03.load.js script. Redirects to the newest assetsNN.webcam.io frame with Last-Modified. Used by Monarch.

Resorts embed <div class="luma-NNNN" cam="<camId>"> with js.prismcam.com/luma.js; the cam attribute is the id. Alta's weather JSON also gives archr_cam_id. Returns a current 1280x720 JPEG; Last-Modified is about 1 h in the future (clock/timezone bug), so treat small negative ages as fresh. Seen at Alta (65, 88), Sundance (74, 75), Snowbasin (54 Mt Ogden, 115 John Paul Lodge).

provider_patterns.provider: Brownrice (used by all Vail Resorts mountains)
provider_patterns.notes: Stream name is the last path part of the resort's iframe https://player.brownrice.com/embed/<stream>. Returns the current frame as JPEG (PHP, no Last-Modified, Access-Control-Allow-Origin *). Vail Resorts pages (<resort>/the-mountain/mountain-conditions/mountain-cams.aspx) are behind bot protection for curl; a real browser gets the iframe list. Stream names are case-sensitive (Crestedbuttebar). An offline stream returns a 69,400-byte PNG card ('This webcam is currently scheduled to be offline') with HTTP 200, so the job should treat image/png of that size as down. Independent resorts use the same service (Mt Rose, Purgatory, Monarch, Wolf Creek, Taos, Ski Santa Fe, Ski Apache, Angel Fire, Red River); their pages embed liveN.brownrice.com/embed/<stream>, and player.brownrice.com/snapshot/<stream> still works. Some streams also have https://liveN.brownrice.com/cam-images/<stream>.jpg with a real Last-Modified (Taos on live4, Angel Fire on live3), but only on the stream's own host. Caution: when a stream stops without being scheduled offline, the snapshot keeps serving the last frame (Sipapu Upper: frame from 2026-09-01 still served on 2026-09-26), so a Brownrice snapshot is not proof of freshness; cam-images Last-Modified reveals it where available.
Only the Kirkwood stake was seen in use (Sept); other resorts may add stake stills here in winter. Has Last-Modified.
